subject: Mutual Action Workshop: proposed milestones, owners and timeline options
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual Action Workshop: proposed milestones, owners and timeline options

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Good discovery call — clear security and procurement gates, and solid alignment on the integration scope. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan draft and a short list of timeline options so we can lock a working plan and owners.

Attachments: Greenline_MAP_v1.xlsx; Discovery_Notes_20270106.pdf

High-level proposal (initial draft):
- Target close (option A - faster): 6 weeks from kickoff (target: 2027-02-19)
  - Milestones: POC env & test data (Redwood), SSO setup & pen-test scheduling (Greenline), Pricing & terms review (procurement)
- Target close (option B - conservative): 10 weeks from kickoff (target: 2027-03-25)
  - Adds extra buffer for procurement and SSO timelines

Proposed milestone owners (draft):
- Redwood: POC environment + integration support — owner: Ethan Park
- Greenline: Security review + SSO configuration — owner: Elena Ruiz
- Procurement: Commercial & PO issuance — owner: Greenline procurement team

Open dependencies (from discovery):
- SAML SSO details and vendor contact (Greenline)
- SOC 2 evidence/brief (we can surface our SOC 2 report; will need to map controls)
- Any network/IP allowlist windows required for POC

Asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm who from Greenline should be listed as stakeholders on the MAP (security, integrations, procurement).
2) Which timeline option do you prefer (Option A - faster, Option B - conservative) or propose an alternative target close date.
3) Availability for a 60 min MAP kickoff workshop next week (I can send a calendar invite).

If it's helpful, I can update the attached MAP with your stakeholders and re-circulate (v1.1) before the workshop.

Thanks — looking forward to getting a short kickoff scheduled.

—
Ethan Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Workshop: proposed milestones, owners and timeline options

On Fri, Jan 8, 2027 at 3:12 PM Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena —
> 
> Thanks again for the time today. Good discovery call — clear security and procurement gates, and solid alignment on the integration scope. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan draft and a short list of timeline options so we can lock a working plan and owners.

Thanks Ethan — this is very helpful and aligns with how we see the work. Confirming Greenline stakeholders to include on the MAP:
- Elena Ruiz (Security lead) — elena.ruiz@greenlinehealth.com
- Marco Alvarez (IT Ops / SSO) — marco.alvarez@greenlinehealth.com
- Priya Shah (Procurement lead) — priya.shah@greenlinehealth.com

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Procurement prefers a conservative timeline given PO cycles; can we tentatively plan for the conservative option (Option B) but flag the faster option as a stretch goal?
- SSO: Marco will need the SAML metadata and a short runbook; I attached our SSO requirements doc to this reply.

Attachments: Greenline_SSO_requirements.pdf

Proposed next step: schedule the MAP kickoff the week of Jan 11 — mornings preferred for our team (PST). If you can share the v1.1 with the stakeholders filled in, we can validate during the kickoff.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Information Security | Greenline Health
elena.ruiz@greenlinehealth.com

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ethan_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Workshop: proposed milestones, owners and timeline options (internal)

Ethan / Jordan —

Thanks — quick internal alignment note before we re-send to Greenline:
- I agree with Elena that Option B should be the baseline to avoid procurement churn; propose we set a working target of close by 2027-04-15 (gives procurement + SSO + security review buffer).
- Owners (suggested final mapping):
  - Redwood (Ethan): POC env, integration support, test plan
  - Redwood (Jordan): Pricing/terms and final SOW coordination with procurement
  - Greenline (Elena): Security signoff, scope confirmation
  - Greenline (Marco): SSO configuration / test window
  - Greenline (Priya): Procurement/PO issuance

Dependencies to call out in MAP v1.1:
- Greenline to provide SAML metadata and preferred test window (Marco)
- Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary & control mappings (we can send a 2-page brief)
- Procurement timeline (Priya) — need target approval date or sprint windows for PO

Action items (internal):
- Ethan: Update MAP v1 -> v1.1 with stakeholder column + Option B baseline and send to Elena for validation (owner: Ethan, due: 2027-01-11 EOD).
- Jordan: Prepare pricing summary and draft SOW language for procurement (due: 2027-01-14).

I'll be on the kickoff call to own orchestration, and we should include a short decision gate at the end of the workshop (ready to schedule POC kickoff or hold).

—
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenlinehealth.com>, Marco Alvarez <marco.alvarez@greenlinehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP v1.1 (kickoff invite + updated milestones, owners, and timeline)

Hi Elena / Marco / Priya —

Per our thread and internal alignment, attached is MAP v1.1 (Greenline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx) — updated with stakeholder names, Option B as the baseline, and a recommended milestone schedule that targets 2027-04-15 close. I also included a short decision gate at the end of the workshop (Go/No-Go for POC kickoff).

Attachments: Greenline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (new); Discovery_Notes_20270106.pdf (reference)

Key highlights in v1.1:
- Baseline target: 2027-04-15 (Option B) with stretch target: 2027-03-25 (Option A)
- Milestones and owners (short):
  - Kickoff & requirements review (owner: Elena) — workshop to confirm acceptance criteria
  - SSO metadata exchange & test window (owner: Marco) — Redwood provides integration checklist
  - SOC 2 brief & control mapping (owner: Redwood) — delivery: 3 business days after kickoff
  - Commercial review & PO issuance (owner: Priya) — target PO date to be confirmed by procurement

Next steps — please confirm by replying to this thread with the following by EOD Wed 2027-01-13:
1) Confirm stakeholders above are correct (Elena / Marco / Priya as primary contacts)
2) Confirm baseline timeline (we've set 2027-04-15) or propose an alternate target close date
3) Share any additional dependencies or blackout windows we should account for
4) Confirm 60-minute MAP kickoff — suggested slots (PST): Jan 12 @ 9:30am, Jan 13 @ 10:00am, Jan 14 @ 11:00am — pick one and I'll send a calendar invite

If I don't hear back by EOD Wednesday we'll default to scheduling the kickoff for Jan 13 @ 10:00am and proceed with Option B as baseline.

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.

—
Ethan Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
